svg.title: Make a move — validation, broadcast and the AI reply
svg.desc: Use case: a seated player moves (after the pipeline of UML 09). GameRoom holds its mutex only inside submit_move: LockAndDrain is created on entry and destroyed on return. Replies go to the mover, the opponent and spectators; in an AI game the engine answers on the same worker.
